svg.title: Figure 3 | Simulated acceptance: access to financial data
svg.desc: Teaching scenario: all results are synthetic. Select an identity to compare policy with observation. The fixed assumption is excessive access for the ordinary employee; the other two cases meet policy for their tested operations. No connections or real logins occur, and these cases do not establish whole-system acceptance.

g.text: Figure 3 | Simulated acceptance: access to financial data
External guest
Expected policy: cannot read announcements or financial data
Observed: both reads denied
Tested operations match policy
Still check normal business functions for approved employees.
Ordinary employee
Expected policy: can read announcements, but not financial data
Observed: announcements readable, but the salary list also opens
Behavior violates policy
Investigate effective file and group permissions for the excessive
read access.
Finance staff
Expected policy: can read announcements and financial data
Observed: both are readable
Tested operations match policy
This tests reading only; test modification and deletion separately
against policy.
Teaching scenario: all results are synthetic. Select an identity to compare
policy with observation. The fixed assumption is excessive access for the
ordinary employee; the other two cases meet policy for their tested
operations. No connections or real logins occur, and these cases do not
establish whole-system acceptance.
